<section class="page-hero"><div class="eyebrow">About / Working philosophy</div><h1>Start with the question.</h1><p>I work where business questions, analytics systems, and delivery leadership meet — translating operational complexity into clear decisions and measurable execution.</p></section>

<section class="reading-section"><div class="eyebrow">A useful operating rhythm</div><h2>The work is not the dashboard.</h2><p>The work is the decision that becomes clearer because the dashboard exists. Across analytics delivery, business intelligence, training and product leadership, the thread has stayed consistent: clarify the question, shape the evidence, and give the person who has to act a more useful view.</p><div class="principle-grid"><article><span>01</span><h3>Question first</h3><p>Begin with the decision and the person responsible for it.</p></article><article><span>02</span><h3>Evidence second</h3><p>Choose the right signal, level of detail and operating cadence.</p></article><article><span>03</span><h3>Execution always</h3><p>Make the result useful in the workflow where action happens.</p></article></div></section>

<section class="reading-section reading-section--light"><div class="eyebrow">Beyond the resume</div><h2>Useful is a practice.</h2><p>The best work is often the work that makes the next conversation simpler: a clearer metric, a better handoff, a calmer operating rhythm, or an analyst who now knows how to explain the signal.</p></section>
